nodes.label: poster-studio: browser poster designer + Etsy listing-factory for themappedmoment.com
nodes.description: A React/Vite frontend + Node/Express API + SQLite, deployed at https://themappedmoment.com (Nginx static + poster-studio-api.service:3001). Sells star-map and street-map posters via a professional SVG template system (draggable text, custom fonts, 300 DPI export). A separate 'listing-factory' pipeline turns competitor references into fresh Etsy listing drafts. 4 public listings; production DB is the source of truth for manually-edited templates.
